verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents that compliance teams can configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores, and cases can be filtered by customer risk. That covers the configuration half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to inspect why a customer's risk score changed. The case audit trail logs case activity, not risk-score drivers or score history. Missing for 10: documented risk-factor configuration details, a risk-score change history or explanation view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
